_comment: Reference intervals and critical limits for one deployment.
Point REFERENCE_CONFIG_PATH at a copy of this file.
Every unit must match the canonical unit this pipeline emits for that
analyte (see app/pipeline/units.py, CANONICAL). A limit in any other unit
is never compared, which means the analyte is silently never assessed --
so a mismatch refuses to boot rather than passing quietly.
Each section replaces the shipped table wholesale rather than merging
into it. A half-replaced table would leave nobody able to tell which
analytes their own file governs and which fell through to values nobody
at their institution approved. Omit a section entirely to keep the
shipped illustrative values for it -- and note that those are

provenance.note: In-house reference interval study, 2025 Q4. Paediatric intervals are not covered by this file.
